jobs.description:
CE-chauffør søges – nat-dag tur Jylland–Sjælland

Fast ugentlig tur:

Vi søger en erfaren CE-chauffør til fast kørsel mellem Skanderborg og Sjælland – med start søndag nat/mandag og slut fredag.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

• 
Start Skanderborg ca. kl. 23.00

• 
2–3 stop på Sjælland

• 
Retur med anden trailer

• 
Trailerbytte i Taulov eller Skanderborg – så slut

• 
Kørsel fra søndag nat/mandag til fredag

• 
Ca. 11-12 timers arbejde pr. dag

Vi forventer

• 
CE-kørekort

• 
Erfaring med trailerkørsel

• 
Ansvarlig, stabil og selvstændig

• 
Trives med nat-start og faste ruter

Vi tilbyder

• 
Forudsigelig ugerute

• 
Selvstændigt arbejde med tillid

• 
Løn efter ATL-overenskomst

• 
Ordentlighed og faste rammer

Send ansøgning til job@24group.dkeller ring til os på 28199818 for mere info.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

English version:

CE Driver Wanted – Night-Day Route Jutland–Zealand

Fixed weekly route. Night start

We are looking for an experienced CE driver for a fixed run between Skanderborg and Zealand – starting Sunday night/Monday and ending Friday.

What does the job involve?

• 
Start in Skanderborg at approx. 23:00

• 
2–3 stops on Zealand

• 
Return with a different trailer

• 
Trailer swap in Taulov or Skanderborg – then end of shift

• 
Driving from Sunday night/Monday through Friday

• 
Approx. 11-12 hours of work per day

We expect you to:

• 
Hold a valid CE license

• 
Have experience with truck + trailer

• 
Be responsible, stable, and self-sufficient

• 
Thrive with night starts and fixed routes

We offer:

• 
Predictable weekly route

• 
Independent work with trust

• 
Pay according to the ATL collective agreement

• 
Honesty, structure, and clear frameworks

Send your application to job@24group.dkor call us at 28199818 for more information.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions

• Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality

• Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach

• Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production

• Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder

• Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality

• Can read and understand technical drawings

• Are reliable and a team player

• Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment

• Speak Danish and/or English

• Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.Your mission- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilitiesYour profile- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)- Fluent in English and preferably GermanBenefits- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discountsYour next step - get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable AssetsAt PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.Your responsibilities include:- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.What you Bring and your QualitiesWe expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.Experience the Highest Degree of InvolvementPEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.Interested and want to know more?If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.
